title: Attribution
description: What a record's publication does not already say about where its text comes from: page numbers and errata. The publisher and book are the publication's own (publication.yml).

page.description: Page number where the content can be found

url.description: URL where the content can be found (for third-party content)

publisher.description: Only when the record's publisher isn't the publication's

book.description: Only when the record's book isn't the publication's title
